fusions.name: Headlong Butt
fusions.desc: You rush up to 6 tiles to the target and butt it for 13 damage, leaving it 12% easier to wound for 5 seconds and [Inescapable] for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Off the Ledge
fusions.desc: Kicks out with both hooves, dealing 24 damage plus 4% of a boss's or elite's maximum health to every enemy within 3 tiles, and knocks each back 3 tiles.

fusions.name: Planted Hooves
fusions.desc: Raises your armour by 25% for 10 seconds.

fusions.name: Hold the Ledge
fusions.desc: Every time you take damage, a stack builds on you, up to 6. When you reach 6, they all spend at once: you gain a shield that soaks 7% of your maximum health per stack (42% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 10 seconds.
